name: srad
description: Speckle Reducing Anisotropic Diffusion (srad_v2): iterative image denoising stencil.

output_parser.comment: Each line is '<index>\t<value>'; compare column 2 (J pixel value) by index.

tolerance.comment: Float stencil iterated 100x; a correct --fmad=false port matches the CPU golden closely. Tolerance catches real logic/indexing bugs while absorbing benign float-order differences in the ROI reduction.

build.comment: Correctness build disables FMA contraction to match the CPU serial bit-closely; perf build uses defaults (FMA on) for realistic timing.
